name: Fresh — فريش
author: Sellchaze
description: A friendly grocery & fresh-market theme: green primary with a lime accent on a cream canvas, pill shapes, a delivery-time promise in the header, big quick-add buttons with quantity steppers on cards, category circles, weekly deals with a countdown and a sticky bottom tab bar on phones — built on the shared section library so every block is editable in the customizer.
changelog: 1.0.0 (2026-09-05): Initial release — grocery / fresh-market theme on the shared section library.
